description: Edit a LinkedIn event the Page organizes: name, description, start / end time, the join or info url, the in-person address or venue details, or discoveryMode (LISTED / URL_ONLY). LinkedIn’s own rules, quoted back when it refuses: an event can be edited only BEFORE it starts (never once cancelled), and online vs in-person never changes. Read back from LinkedIn. 0 credits.
